title: Day 37 of building GTA 6 using claude
author: SneakerHunterDev
selftext:
Building a GTA Online clone in voxel style where the world never sleeps and all the NPCs are AI agents. Everything is built by players using prompts. Prompt your own car. Prompt your own building. Prompt your own weapon.

**New this week**: much bigger map, better police, and new quests (you can now deal drugs ;) ). I also started building with Fable now that it's back.

Thank you all for the feedback over the last weeks. I read every comment and I'll keep doing it! I took all of your ideas into account and already built most of them into this update.

Because of the large map the game is a bit more laggy on high settings right now. Working on it!

Still looking for people to give me their brutally honest opinion. Tell me what's fun, what's  boring, and what exactly needs to change so you'd love this.

Play here: [https://theflairgame.com/](https://theflairgame.com/)

comments.author: Prior-Meeting1645
comments.body: Is this with fable? Are they made with blocks on purpose?

replies.author: SneakerHunterDev
replies.body: Yes, 10% fable 90% Opus. I used a Blocky Style because it’s just easier. Wish I could do realistic Graphics but this is a huge effort even besides a great game loop but maybe the next prototype!

comments.author: Cool-Chemical-5629
comments.body: I've been following the progress sporadically and I kinda wish you made a single player portion too. Multiplayer is not my cup of coffee in this type of games.

replies.author: SneakerHunterDev
replies.body: Yes, I have seen your comments! Really appreciate the Feedback! The Problem is Right now everything is Completely focused on being Multiplayer. If you think about a Story Mode of what exactly are you thinking? A gta like story campaign?

replies.author: Cool-Chemical-5629
replies.body: Yeah, GTA like story campaign would be cool. You obviously got pretty far, it feels like it'd be shame if there was no story. It would probably prolong the development significantly, but I think it would be worth it, because it looks like a pretty polished game already. I think giving it its own story would only make it better.

replies.author: SneakerHunterDev
replies.body: Okay I hear you! I also implemented some Small quests and Jobs in the online world which have some Kind of Story character. If Players like it I can definitely consider doing a whole Story Mode : )

replies.author: SneakerHunterDev
replies.body:
Become a drug dealer / Mafia boss / build a Business 

But its not a story game so far

replies.author: FinsAssociate
replies.body:
any plans for that?

asking because i look at this and it seems like a tech demo more than anything, and not playable for more than 5 min. no offense

replies.author: SneakerHunterDev
replies.body: My goal in first place is not to make a Story Game but an online Game exactly like GTA online but with a world that actually adapts to what Players do like building their own houses or destroying others. There will be many small Game Loops inside of this similar to gta online like money methods to earn Money to then buy an Office which works for You and so on. It’s about freedom, Status and getting Rich exactly like gta online but with a way more alive world and more Freedom like specifically creating your own weapon, character or building

replies.author: SneakerHunterDev
replies.body: Thanks a lot :D really happy to hear because this what I want to achieve!
